# Redesign a poster while retaining its world

[All prompts](../README.md#collection) · [中文](#中文) · [Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com)

Change the perspective and copy while preserving a poster’s overall visual structure.

## Prompt



```text
Using the original poster as reference, retain its overall composition and visual world. Reinterpret it from a male perspective and replace all visible text with new copy that fits the revised concept.
```

## Required inputs

- The original poster. For production work, provide the exact replacement copy.

## Notes

- English adaptation of the Japanese instruction. The original post labels the new result on the left and the earlier-model original on the right.
